انتظموا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَظَمُوا (intaẓamū) /in.ta.ðˤa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
# اُنْتُظِمُوا (untuẓimū) /un.tu.ðˤi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
# اِنْتَظِمُوا (intaẓimū) /in.ta.ðˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
